project_info.theme: Premium wireless over-ear headphone product launch
project_info.color_palette: White, light gray, lime green, pastel pink, silver, black mesh, and rainbow prism accents

main_subject.type: Product hero shot and fashion model
main_subject.detail: Extreme close-up of a hand holding a sleek matte-white premium over-ear headphone toward camera at a slight low angle. Behind it, a smiling freckled woman with wavy pastel-pink hair, a lime knit beanie, and a black-and-white striped shirt wears the headphones around her neck.
main_subject.style: Hyperreal commercial product photography meets editorial fashion advertising; tack-sharp product, shallow macro depth of field, clean premium e-commerce styling

composition_elements.type: Feature callouts, product details, floating props, and oversized typography
composition_elements.text: Apple Pods Pro 3; HEADPHONES; Premium Sound; 40 Hours Battery; 0 to 100% Fast Charge; 1 Year Warranty; Bluetooth 5.4; Spatial Audio; AI-Enhanced Mic
items: Center foreground: dominant hand-held white headphone, brushed silver outer cup, black mesh grille, embossed product branding, touch-control marks, and a tiny green LED.
Center mid-ground: relaxed smiling pink-haired woman, lime beanie and striped shirt, with a second white headphone pair around her neck.
Top background: massive semi-transparent white 'HEADPHONES' spanning the poster behind the model; product lockup near the top edge.
Left and right: white sound, battery, charging, and warranty icon callouts with stacked large numerals and concise feature copy.
Background: light gray-to-warm-white studio gradient, 4-5 blurred floating white headphones, subtle bokeh, diagonal rainbow prism flares, and soft pink/yellow light leaks.
Bottom: small horizontal connectivity, spatial-audio, and microphone feature strip.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Upper-left key light, right-side fill, rear rim light, natural glossy headphone highlights, soft bokeh, rainbow prism lens flare, pastel light leaks

technical_specs.render_style: Hyperrealistic 85mm macro commercial photography and editorial advertising layout

assets.name: Approved over-ear headphone product reference
assets.source: official product photography or licensed hardware reference
assets.usage: Match the exact headphone geometry, materials, branding, ports, and controls in the foreground and around the model's neck.

assets.name: Licensed pink-haired model reference
assets.source: model release-cleared photograph or an approved generated character reference
assets.usage: Match facial features, freckles, wavy pink hair, lime beanie, striped shirt, pose, and expression.

assets.name: Approved brand wordmark and icon
assets.usage: Use only in the top product lockup and product embossing; replace Apple-related marks if no authorization exists.

assets.name: Vertical headphone feature-callout layout
assets.usage: Preserve the oversized background headline, side callouts, and bottom specification strip.

assets.name: Studio gradient and rainbow prism reference
assets.usage: Recreate the gray-white backdrop, floating blurred headphones, bokeh, and restrained diagonal prism flare.

prompt_instructions: Attach the real product, approved model, and authorized logo assets for faithful regeneration.
The 'Apple Pods Pro 3' name and Apple-like marks in the reference must be treated as unverified; use only approved product naming, branding, and substantiated claims.
Keep all typography sharp and legible, but do not claim specifications, warranty, or performance figures without approval.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: High-impact e-commerce infographic for 'Apple Pods Pro 3' premium wireless over-ear headphones. FOREGROUND - PRODUCT HERO SHOT: Extreme close-up of a hand holding a sleek, matte-white premium over-ear headphone toward the camera at a slight angle. The headphone features glossy white ear cushions with soft memory foam padding; a brushed aluminum silver headband with subtle Apple Pods Pro 3 embossed branding; black mesh speaker grille visible on the ear cup face; a tiny glowing green LED status indicator on the right ear cup edge; and subtle touch-control icons etched on the outer cup surface. Macro-lens shallow depth of field - hand and headphone slightly blurred at edges to create cinematic depth. Product remains razor-sharp in center frame. CENTRAL SUBJECT - MODEL: In the mid-ground, a smiling young woman with freckles and wavy pastel-pink hair. She wears a vibrant lime-green knit beanie, a psychedelic black and white-striped long-sleeve shirt, and the white over-ear headphones resting stylishly around her neck (not on ears), with one hand casually touching the ear cup. Expression: relaxed, confident, joyful. She is glancing slightly off-camera with a natural smile. BACKGROUND & ATMOSPHERE: Clean soft-focus studio backdrop, light gray gradient fading to warm white at center. Atmospheric overlays: diagonal rainbow prism lens flares cutting across upper-left to lower-right; soft pastel light leaks in pink and yellow at corners; 4-5 blurred white over-ear headphones floating artistically in the background at various depths and rotation angles; subtle bokeh circles from background studio lights. Lighting: Soft professional three-point studio lighting. Key light from upper-left, fill light right side. Rim light behind model for separation. Glossy highlights on headphone surfaces catching light naturally. TYPOGRAPHY & LAYOUT - Sans-Serif, Clean white: TOP CENTER (behind model, large background text): massive bold oversized text 'HEADPHONES', semi-transparent white, spanning full width behind subject. TOP RIGHT CORNER: bold clean text 'Apple Pods Pro 3'; subtitle smaller text 'Over-Ear Wireless'. MID LEFT: icon small sound wave symbol; bold text 'Premium Sound'; sub-text 'Active Noise Cancellation + Transparency Mode'. MID RIGHT: extra-large bold numeral '40'; smaller text below 'hours of battery life'. LOWER LEFT: extra-large bold numeral '0' with 'to' beside it, then bold '100%'; sub-text 'Fast charge - 10 min = 3hrs playback'. BOTTOM RIGHT: extra-large bold numeral '1'; sub-text 'Year Warranty Included'. BOTTOM CENTER (fine print style): small elegant text 'Bluetooth 5.4 | Hi-Res Audio Certified | Foldable Design | USB-C Charging'. TECHNICAL SPECS: Resolution 8K ultra-sharp. Style: Commercial product photography meets editorial fashion advertising. Color Palette: White, lime green, pastel pink, rainbow prism accents. Focus: Tack-sharp on headphone product, shallow DOF on everything else. Lens: 85mm macro, slight low angle. Render Quality: Hyperrealistic, clean ad aesthetic, vibrant yet professional color grading.
prompt.negative_prompt: dark background, low-resolution product, blurry hero product, distorted headphones, warped hands, duplicate fingers, unreadable typography, unsupported product claims, unlicensed logo, excessive rainbow flare, harsh shadows, watermark, signature
